_comment: Fictional demo business. Replace with your own facts; the agent only states what is here.
description: A small neighborhood bike shop: tune-ups, repairs and assembly for city, road, mountain and electric bikes (mechanical work only).

location.landmark: Two blocks from the train station
location.parking: Leave your bike by the front door while you are helped.

contact.note: The assistant does not send messages or emails.

appointments.explanation: Each appointment is a 60-minute drop-off and assessment. Longer jobs keep the bike at the shop; the pickup date is given in person.

services.name: General check-up
services.description: Inspection, basic brake and gear adjustment, tire pressure and chain lube. Good when you are not sure what is wrong.

services.name: Full service
services.description: Drivetrain, hub and headset cleaning and greasing plus a general tune. The bike usually stays at the shop.

services.name: Brake check and adjustment
services.description: Rim or disc brake adjustment, and new pads if needed.

services.name: Flat tire repair
services.description: Patch or replace the inner tube and check the tire.

services.name: Gear adjustment
services.description: Derailleur tuning and cable check so gears stop skipping.

services.name: E-bike mechanical check-up
services.description: Brakes, drivetrain, wheels and visible connections. Battery and motor repair are not included.

policies.pricing: Prices are given at the shop after the bike is assessed. The assistant does not quote prices by phone.
policies.what_to_bring: The bike. For e-bikes, bring the charger too.
